storage: Keep in the coldest part of the fridge and cook within a day or two, or freeze in a sealed bag; thaw in the fridge, not on the counter.
looksLike: Raw chicken cut into small pieces (about 12 to 16 per 500 g) with the bone left in and the skin removed; pale pink meat with white bone.
howToPick: Fresh pink flesh, no sour or strong smell, no slime, pieces cold and firmly packed. Avoid grey patches, sticky surface or a pool of liquid in the pack.
shelfLife: Raw chicken keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 170 g per serving (about 120 g edible meat; 4 small pieces)
